observed_storage_wait_and_cache_recovery.interpretation: Own clean checkpoint page-cache advice reduced memory and was followed by exit from filesystem wait and resumed generation. Underlying kernel/XFS mechanism not independently proved; not evidence this caused model quality changes.

gap_evidence_correction.scope: All selected teacher answers remain fixture-verified. The correction concerns evidence of student inability, not teacher answer validity.

certified_gap_mechanism_descriptive.interpretation: One certified task: confusing tool version with file version metadata, plus an unsupported option. Exit code zero alone did not establish task success.

pre_outcome_tool_coverage.interpretation: Frozen panels emphasize tool transfer; this diagnostic does not establish causal failure or change selection. Stable gap tools are not represented by these held-out panels. TRAIN-fit reports only fit, not generalization.

supervision_objective_composition.interpretation: Equal replay example exposure does not equal replay token or per-step loss coefficient mass under token-normalized loss. Actual gradients also depend on token losses and derivatives.
